auto_category_hint: 💡 Hearth picks the category for you as you type.
note_placeholder: Anything specific the shopper needs to know
urgent_hint: Urgent items appear at the top of the list.
remove_body: It'll be taken off {{list}}. If you bought it, mark it done instead — that way it stays in your history.
empty_items_body: Tap + Add item to start filling it up.
tutorial_step1_body: Keep groceries, hardware, and pharmacy separate so the right person can grab the right list on the way out the door. Tap any list to open it.
tutorial_step2_title: Check items off as you shop
tutorial_step2_body: Tap any item to mark it done. Items are grouped by category so you can work through one aisle at a time.
tutorial_step3_body: Type something like '2 lemons' in the quick-add bar and Hearth will parse the quantity and auto-detect the category for you.
